wordProblems.q: Layla collects 15 shells on Saturday and 40 shells on Sunday. Layla gives 35 shells to a friend. How many shells does Layla have left?
Mia has 19 balloons. Mia buys twice as many balloons as Mia already has, plus 8 more. How many balloons does Mia have now?
Lily, Emma and Amelia each have 7 pencils. Their teacher gives them 14 more pencils to share. How many pencils do they have in all?
Mason has 34 stickers. Mason gives away 19 stickers, then buys 4 packs with the same number of stickers left in each pack. How many stickers does Mason buy?
There are 44 red cars and 22 blue cars in a car park. 9 cars drive away. How many cars are left in the car park?
A ticket costs $6. Lucas buys 5 tickets and a snack for $9. How many dollars does Lucas spend in all?
Emma buys 2 packs of 8 pens and 2 packs of 6 pencils. How many pens and pencils does Emma buy in all?
69 children go on a school trip. 24 children ride in the first bus. The rest ride in the second bus. How many children ride in the second bus?
A baker makes 5 trays with 12 cookies on each tray. Her family eats 9 cookies. How many cookies are left?
Owen plants 5 rows of carrots with 6 carrots in each row. Then Owen plants 6 more carrots. How many carrots did Owen plant in all?
Adam saves $9 every week for 4 weeks. Then Adam spends $6 on a game. How many dollars does Adam have left?
A library has 6 shelves with 10 books on each shelf. The librarian adds 12 more books. How many books are there in all?
A shop has 6 boxes with 10 apples in each box. The shop sells 32 apples. How many apples are left?
Grace has 54 red beads and 35 blue beads. Grace uses 39 beads to make a necklace. How many beads does Grace have left?
A cook has 4 cartons with 12 eggs in each carton. She uses 27 eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs are left?
Omar scores 29 points in the first game and 19 points in the second game. Omar gets 9 bonus points. How many points does Omar have in all?
A farmer fills 8 baskets with 8 oranges in each basket. He gives 15 oranges to his neighbours. How many oranges are left?
Nora is reading a book with 100 pages. Nora reads 21 pages on Monday and 70 pages on Tuesday. How many pages are left to read?
A class has 4 groups with 5 children in each group. 6 children are away today. How many children are at school?
Noah has 5 bags with 3 stickers in each bag. Noah gives 5 stickers to a friend. How many stickers does Noah have left?
Emma has 25 ribbons. Her mum gives her twice as many ribbons as she already has, then Emma gives 13 ribbons to a friend. How many ribbons does Emma have now?
A shop has 4 crates with 7 bottles of juice in each crate. The shop sells 17 bottles. How many bottles are left?
Ruby scores 15 points on Monday, 10 points on Tuesday and 17 points on Wednesday. How many points does Ruby score in all?
Chloe plants 7 rows of beans with 7 seeds in each row. 28 seeds grow into plants. How many seeds do not grow?
An adult ticket costs $6 and a child ticket costs $3. James buys 2 adult tickets and 4 child tickets. How many dollars does James spend in all?
James is reading a book with 83 pages. James reads 12 pages on Friday and 55 pages on Saturday. How many pages are left to read?
A market has 3 baskets with 7 apples in each basket and 4 baskets with 6 pears in each basket. The market sells 8 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit are left?
A cook bakes 4 trays with 6 cupcakes on each tray. The children eat 10 cupcakes. How many cupcakes are left?
Chloe has $86. Chloe buys a ball for $13 and a hat for $44. How many dollars does Chloe have left?
Ben fills 6 jars with 6 strawberries in each jar. Then Ben picks 7 more strawberries. How many strawberries does Ben have in all?
